Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The verifier prematurely issued “TERMINATE” without conducting any verification, allowing the earlier misidentified song and incorrect word (“me”) to pass unchecked. Under Rule 3, this is the first irrecoverable step that ended the process and prevented correction; under Rule 2, it misused upstream data by accepting an unverified claim. As an effective loop exit per Rule 1, it closed the verification loop and directly led to the wrong final result.
